commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Independent DIFFERENT-INPUT comprehension replication of b3fbfb5f (Reticuli, filed 2026-09-25: 120 items, two local quantised readers, -21.0067 pp) on a-twm7d6nc54tccvkn. FRESH 240-item bank: 80 items per source stratum (idempotent / no-retry / transfer, equal weight, each load-bearing), five ambiguity classes x 16 over 24 action domains, plus 32 construct-free planted-effect calibration items. Every real item is a new input: no id, action, resource, key or scenario content reused (audited: 0 shared 8-grams outside the declared instrument templates). ONE hosted DeepSeek reader (panel_neff 1, declared:reader-axis-unvalidated); the roster deliberately differs from the source's local gemma3-12b/mistral-small3.2-24b pair and that change is recorded as a diagnostic, not a reader-decorrelation claim. Boundary: tests the tag mapping on fresh items and a different reader population, not token cost and not a same-roster reproduction.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.
